title: The reach and limits of slope eikonal equations in compact spaces
summary: It is a well known fact that the eikonal equation is well posed in complete length spaces. Among the studied notions of solutions in the literature, there is one that can be defined in any metric space using the local (descent) slope and considering pointwise solutions: functionals such that their slope coincides with the prescribed data at every point of the domain. In this work we explore the question ``Can we characterize the class of compact metric spaces in which every slope eikonal equation (under standard assumptions) always admits a pointwise solution?''.
